description: Every RAR stack — a drop-in pack (agent(s) + optional .egg + pack.json sha256 manifest) that plants something bigger than a single agent: a neighborhood, a fleet controller, a lifecycle kit, or a private rapp-workspace/1.1 vault. Each stack's files are individually sha256-pinned and independently fetchable — a client can take a whole stack or cherry-pick files across stacks since every entry is a content-addressed manifest.

stacks.name: fleet-management
stacks.purpose: Drop-in pack that turns one brainstem into a fleet controller for a network of Mac-mini brainstems. Two files: fleet_agent.py (the SSH-driven fleet adapter — discover, authorize, exec, read, write, tail, chat any twin on any peer, mesh-exec, mesh-chat, plus brainstem-aware actions like provision_brainstem / install_agent / hatch_egg / boot_federation; AND escape-hatch actions custom / extend / cap / list_caps so the brainstem can invent new capabilities at runtime) + twin_egg_hatcher_agent.py (the generic single-file scale-aware hatcher used to deploy agents / twins / neighborhoods / containers across the fleet). Together they make the entire local mini fleet addressable from one brainstem chat. Pairs with the organism-lifecycle stack (Twin + EggHatcher) for full peer-to-peer federation. SSH key-auth required; first run of action='authorize' generates a key and emits the one-line paste command for each mini operator.

fleet_agent.py.purpose: Drop into local brainstem agents/. Run Fleet to drive remote minis (any number of actions: shell, files, deploys, chat, mesh, AND custom/extend for new capabilities).

twin_egg_hatcher_agent.py.purpose: Scale-aware single-file hatcher (agent / twin / neighborhood / swarm / factory / industry / estate eggs). Required on every peer mini Fleet talks to. Also useful locally for hatching .egg files from other operators.

install.notes: Drop both files into your brainstem's agents/ directory. load_agents() picks them up on the next /chat — no restart. The LLM gets Fleet(...) and HatchTwinEgg(...) as tools immediately. To deploy to a peer mini: (1) Fleet(action='authorize', host='<mini>.local') and paste the printed line on the mini's terminal; (2) Fleet(action='provision_brainstem', host='<mini>.local'); (3) Fleet(action='hatch_egg', host='<mini>.local', egg_url='http://your-host:8765/some.egg'); (4) Fleet(action='boot_federation', host='<mini>.local'). Or just describe it in natural language and the brainstem composes the calls itself.

stacks.name: microsoft-365-team
stacks.purpose: Drop-in pack for Microsoft Solution Engineers. Two files: factory_agent.py (plants new MS-themed neighborhoods under your GitHub handle in 4 modes: local/private/public/egg) + microsoft-365-team.egg (the canonical content — 11 agents including WorkIQ for M365 access, MS-stack-shaped Twin with field patterns for Copilot Studio / Power Platform / consent delays, plus the canonical workflow gate set). Sneakernet-portable per the kernel two-file rule. PII never enters the planted repo by default per PUBLIC_PRIVATE_BOUNDARY §1.5.

factory_agent.py.purpose: Drop into local brainstem agents/. Run NeighborhoodFactory to plant.

microsoft-365-team.egg.purpose: Template content (11 agents). The factory pulls + customizes this at plant time.

stacks.name: neighborhood-starter
stacks.purpose: The canonical starter pack for planting a new RAPP neighborhood. Two files: factory_agent.py (drops into your local brainstem; the meta-agent that plants neighborhoods) + neighborhood-starter.egg (the template content, parameterized for the user's choices). Supports four modes: local-only on-device, GitHub-private, GitHub-public, or fresh portable .egg.

factory_agent.py.purpose: Drop into local brainstem agents/. Run NeighborhoodFactory to plant.

neighborhood-starter.egg.purpose: Template content. The factory pulls + customizes this at plant time.

stacks.name: organism-lifecycle
stacks.purpose: Two agents that turn a vanilla brainstem into a full organism host: Twin (summon/hatch/boot/stop/list/inspect — full digital-twin lifecycle) + EggHatcher (universal .egg cartridge router that introspects manifest.schema/type and dispatches to organism / rapplication / session / neighborhood / estate). Both were kernel-shipped through 2026-05-10; relocated to RAR so the base install stays minimal and operators opt in when they're ready to host sub-twins or take in eggs. Drop both files into your brainstem's agents/ and restart.

twin_agent.py.purpose: Full digital-twin lifecycle in one drop-in agent. Source: agents/@rapp/twin_agent.py.

install.notes: Drop both files into your brainstem's agents/ directory and restart. The LLM picks up Twin(...) and HatchEgg(...) as tools on the next /chat request.

stacks.name: rapp-workspace-starter
stacks.purpose: Drop-in pack for a chief-of-staff style private workspace, conformant to rapp-workspace/1.1: CLAUDE.md/HOME.md/PERSONA.md/where-everything-lives.md, standard sections (strategy/portfolio/projects/reference/people/meetings/connect/role), and the rapp-projects frame authority. WorkspaceFactory pulls + verify_egg()s the canonical template before planting, then re-mints a fresh rappid per instance. Newer shape than the neighborhood-starter/microsoft-365-team stacks: this plants a private organizing VAULT for one owner and one world, not an agent-team neighborhood. public mode is refused by design — a planted workspace holds real PII; only this stack's own template .egg is meant to be public. Ships with WorkspaceNeuron: a generic, PII-free Knowledge Base of the spec's setup/operating rules injected into the brainstem prompt, so a planted workspace's own .md files stay owner-specific instead of re-explaining the protocol.

factory_agent.py.purpose: Drop into local brainstem agents/. Run WorkspaceFactory to plant a workspace.

workspace_neuron_agent.py.purpose: Optional, tool-form. Drop into local brainstem agents/@rapp/ alongside the factory. Injects a compact [Knowledge Base] of rapp-workspace/1.1 + rapp/1 setup and operating rules (anatomy, identity/mint-once, privacy posture, the egg contract, the frame authority) — generic and PII-free, never owner-specific. No install step; the brainstem's agent loader picks it up as a callable tool. Keeps that knowledge out of every planted workspace's CLAUDE.md/README.md prose. Lives only under stacks/ — not submitted to RAR's canonical agents/ registry, which is gated by the GitHub Issue notarization workflow (see CONSTITUTION.md), not a pull request.

neurons/@rapp/rapp_workspace_anatomy.neu.purpose: Optional, storage-form twin of the same knowledge (same content, generated from the same source, never drifts). For a CommunityRAPP-style backend: install with install_neurons.py so it lands in the RAPP Web UI's system prompt automatically, no tool call needed. schema/id/name/version/category/description/scope/author/memories — same shape as install_neurons.py's own @platform/*.neuron.json packs.

neurons/@rapp/rapp_workspace_identity.ne.purpose: Storage-form neuron: mint-once identity rules. See rapp_workspace_anatomy.neuron.json for the delivery-shape note.

neurons/@rapp/rapp_workspace_privacy.neu.purpose: Storage-form neuron: privacy & sovereignty rules (public mode refusal). See rapp_workspace_anatomy.neuron.json for the delivery-shape note.

neurons/@rapp/rapp1_egg_contract.neuron..purpose: Storage-form neuron: the rapp/1 §9 egg contract. See rapp_workspace_anatomy.neuron.json for the delivery-shape note.

neurons/@rapp/rapp_projects_frame_author.purpose: Storage-form neuron: the rapp-projects frame authority (leases, fork recovery). See rapp_workspace_anatomy.neuron.json for the delivery-shape note.

rapp-workspace-starter.egg.purpose: Template content (rapp/1 §9 organism egg, 24 files, PII-free, verify_egg-clean). The factory pulls + verifies + customizes this at plant time.
